Heatherfern sits all night at Bouncepelt's vigil, struggling to cling to comfort she once felt with her kit at her side.

The past moon, Swallowstripe and Bouncepelt have taken their place in StarClan. c_n mourns their loss, and their Clanmates will miss where they had been in their lives. Moments of their lives are shared in stories around the circle of mourners as those that were closest to them take them to their final resting place.
